Job Descriptions

Role

Experience Snapshot

1

3

7+ years data science; 2+ years integrating LLMs via Palantir AIP

4

Palantir Workshop Specialist (Application Developer)

8+ years full-stack/frontend development; 4+ years building inside Palantir

Palantir Architect

12+ years in enterprise data architecture; 5+ years leading large-scale Palantir deployments.
Experience of Palantir Foundry Ontology design, multi-tenant architecture, and Palantir Apollo for continuous deployment.
Deep expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise ERP systems like SAP.
Define the strategic technical roadmap, data governance policies, and cross-platform integration patterns to/from Palantir
Align technical capabilities with business outcomes while aligning to platform health and cost optimization.

Palantir Ontology - Data Engineer

8+ years in data engineering; 4+ years of hands-on pipeline building within Palantir Foundry.
Experience of Data Connection, Contour, Pipeline Builder, and object-oriented Ontology modeling with Palantir
Advanced proficiency in Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, and dbt (Data Build Tool).
Standardize data ingestion frameworks, clean source data, and optimize complex pipeline performance.
Mentor engineering teams on best practices for data lineage, security marking, and semantic modeling.

Palantir AIP - AI/ML Specialist

7+ years in data science; 2+ years integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via Palantir AIP (Artificial Intelligence Platform).
Knowledge of Palantir AIP Logic, AIP Assist, Model Asset Folders, and Workshop AI widgets.
Proficient in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face transformers, RAG pipelines, vector databases like Milvus or Pinecone and Graph DBs like Neo4j.
Architect secure LLM orchestration, agentic workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) within Foundry.
Establish guidelines for AI safety, model evaluation, and cost-effective generative AI application design.
Palantir Workshop Specialist (Application Developer)
8+ years in full-stack or frontend application development; 2+ years building inside Palantir.
Worked on Palantir Workshop, Slate, Functions (TypeScript), and Action frameworks.
Strong foundations in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, CSS, and RESTful API development.
Design high-performance, user-friendly operational applications and decision-making dashboards for executives.

Standardize UI/UX.
